quote: On Nov 30, China's first greenfield solar project in Colombia — the Baranoa Solar PV Project — achieved full-capacity grid connection as Phase II and Phase III entered operation. Invested and built by CTG LatAm, the three-phase project has a total installed capacity of 58.3 MW, generating 110 million kWh of clean power annually, enough for 45,000 households and reducing 98,700 tonnes of CO₂ each year
note: Opened CTG English release 4 Dec 2025 (Baranoa II+III full-capacity COD; 58.3 MW).
